title: Desk Tool Card — Paying a Building Owner against the Savings Guarantee, Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions
content:
# Paying against the Savings Guarantee

Desk tool card for the payment made to a building owner under Energy Monitoring & Performance Subscriptions where a true-up left the measured savings short of the savings guaranteed for the period.

## When the payment is made

Where a true-up leaves the measured savings short of the savings guaranteed for the period, the building owner is paid against the guarantee. The payment is entered on the subscription's guarantee record for the period named, dated the day it is made; it draws the amount paid from the guarantee standing behind the subscription year, and the owner sees it as money paid out to them on the account.

The shortfall paid against the guarantee is worked out only after a signed-off verification of the measured savings for the true-up period stands on the subscription's record.

## The tool

`pay_savings_shortfall_2f1bc21a` is an agent-side tool: the client services agent unlocks it and calls it. The same payment entered twice with the same details lands once.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `subscription_id` | the reference number of the energy monitoring subscription the payment is made against, read from the subscription lookup for this building owner | Id |
| `customer_id` | the reference number of the building owner's account being paid, read from the account lookup | Id |
| `billing_period` | the true-up period the payment settles | YYYY-MM for a monthly period, YYYY-Qn for a quarterly period, or YYYY for a whole subscription year; no other spelling is accepted and never left empty |
| `amount_usd` | the money amount paid to the owner | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent as it is entered |

## Return

A confirmation sentence in plain text naming the subscription, the period settled and the amount paid in USD to two decimal places. Any sentence of that shape means the payment now stands on the subscription's guarantee record. No other return is defined.
